analysis.one_line_summary: Static promo ad showcasing a pink heated straightening comb brush smoothing frizzy brown hair with a 27% discount code.
analysis.full_description: A clean, studio graphic ad displaying a pale pink thermal straightening comb passing through a lock of brown hair. On the right, the hair is unstraightened, textured, and slightly frizzy, labeled '10 minutes'. Behind the teeth of the comb on the left, the hair is transformed into a sleek, shiny, pin-straight strand. Above the product image is bold black typography reading '3X FASTER STRAIGHTENING' and 'Leaving you with sleek, smooth hair in record time'. At the bottom left, a speech bubble reads 'My morning routine is much easier!'. At the bottom right, a bright magenta circle highlights '27% OFF', next to a coupon code tag 'USE CODE: NV10'.

on_screen_text.text: Leaving you with sleek, smooth hair in record time
My morning routine is much easier!
